data.narrative: Mastered dependency mapping and cycle resolution on the SkillSwap marketplace platform, successfully identifying false coupling assumptions and applying state decoupling and node splitting to unlock parallel execution tracks.

dimension_scores.observation: Constructed an acyclic directed graph distinguishing critical path bottlenecks from parallelizable leaf nodes.
dimension_scores.evidence: Mapped unblocked critical path: Auth -> Provider Schema -> Admin Review Tool -> Provider Vetting -> Booking Engine -> Payouts.

dimension_scores.observation: Extracted hidden dependency constraints between draft states, approval workflows, and public listing queries.
dimension_scores.evidence: Identified that provider registration produces draft records prior to admin vetting without requiring full dashboard UI.

dimension_scores.observation: Identified circular dependency vulnerability in provider onboarding and isolated the load-bearing weak assumption.
dimension_scores.evidence: Recognized that treating admin approval as dependent on the full dashboard created an execution deadlock.

dimension_scores.observation: Specified concrete interface and state separation boundaries.
dimension_scores.evidence: Decomposed Admin Dashboard into Admin Review Tool (minimal endpoint) and Admin Dashboard (full analytics).

dimension_scores.observation: Surgically refactored the entire dependency graph to restore execution flow.
dimension_scores.evidence: Updated dependency-graph-fixed.md resolving the cycle within a single iteration.

dimension_scores.observation: Ensured data contracts between pending and active provider states preserve platform integrity.
dimension_scores.evidence: Enforced status field filtering on consumer marketplace search queries.

strengths: Deep grasp of DAG modeling and node decomposition to resolve circular locks.
Clear distinction between critical path blockers and parallel workstreams.
data.recommendation: Apply node splitting routinely when designing features with administrative review lifecycles.

public_evidence.student_action: Constructed and remediated the complete dependency graph for a two-sided marketplace platform.
public_evidence.technical_detail: Decomposed SkillSwap marketplace workflows into an acyclic DAG, resolving a 3-way circular dependency in provider onboarding.
public_evidence.reviewer_value: Demonstrates advanced architectural planning and execution orchestration skills required for complex multi-team software deliveries.
